method.fe: own voxel / finite-cell hexahedra with incompatible modes on the STL (sachta_a/fe3d.py, validated 2-4 % low in plain bending -> x 1.04)
method.joint: positive location only (Z3.7): F10 pads bilateral in y, rail / pad faces compression only, tongue faces z and tongue ends x compression only, F10 dowel x + z; no friction
method.pivot: gear bore on the taped T_cap (radial)
method.axial: retention washer: compression-only stop on the hub lip of the well (rev. 3) / on the gear top (rev. 2); PTFE thrust washer under the gear
method.upper_guide: lift 20: collar-disc opening at z +3 (sachta_a fe_cases_v3); lift 0 / 10: strip tops
method.collar: the glued collar disc of variant B (golier_kotuc, r 26.5, 6 thick) is part of the model up to z +0.5, tied to the well on the glue land r >= 24 (sachta_a: guide forces only, no stiffness - used for the rev. 2 validation with --no-collar)
method.stop: stop pin = compression-only line contact at r 30
method.bond: nodes merged inside the root circle r <= 13.35 (rigid epoxy layer); peel / shear = nodal force / h^2 averaged over 0.6 mm
method.averaging: max principal stress on the true surface averaged over 0.4 mm, x 1.04
method.contact_zones: LD1: structure rows use only surface points >= 1.0 mm (+ h / 2) away from every node of an ACTIVE joint contact (module pairs, dowel, stop line); the mesh-dependent peak inside the zone is kept as contact_zone_peak (information); every contact has its own row: nominal bearing pressure = pair force / engaged area vs the class allowable
method.classes: LD2: L1 / L2 at lift 0 normal 8.5; L1 / L2 at lift > 2 abuse 12.9 (normal use there = 1/3 of the load: 4.3 <= 8.5 by scaling); L8 into a hard stop = fault = abuse 12.9; L3 abuse 12.9
method.bond_acceptance: LD1: nominal average shear and tension <= 2.7 normal / 4.0 abuse; edge peaks information only
method.allowables: T4_zivica Z2: normal 8.5 (L1, L2, L8), abuse 12.9 (L3), unfilleted notch 4.3 / 6.45, bond 2.7; fail-safe rows against the lower-bound strength 25.8 (not a design case)
method.L2_lift10: vertical pin force 30 N in full, servo torque about x capped at the MG90S stall 216 N.mm (beyond it the head sinks)
